$line = (Get-Content "C:\Users\Home\ISOMTRIC\assets\ISOMTRIC.html")[955]; Write-Output "Line length: $($line.Length)"; # Extract the structure keys
if ($line -match '"f":\{') { Write-Output "Has female data" }
# Find all muscle names
$muscles = [regex]::Matches($line, '"m":"([^"]+)"') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value } | Sort-Object -Unique
Write-Output "Muscles: $($muscles -join ', ')"

$line = (Get-Content "C:\Users\Home\ISOMTRIC\assets\ISOMTRIC.html")[955];
# Save the BODY constant to a temp file for easier analysis
$line | Out-File -Encoding utf8 -FilePath "C:\Users\Home\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\body_data.txt"
Write-Output "Saved. File size: $((Get-Item 'C:\Users\Home\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\body_data.txt').Length)"

$content = Get-Content "C:\Users\Home\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\body_data.txt" -Raw
# Count number of path entries
$pathCount = ([regex]::Matches($content, '"d":"')).Count
Write-Output "Total paths: $pathCount"

# Split by the pattern that marks section boundaries
# Front male paths only
$mFrontPaths = [regex]::Matches($content, '"m":"[^"]+","d":"[^"]*"')
Write-Output "Total muscle-labeled paths: $($mFrontPaths.Count)"

# Show muscle groups with their path count
$allMuscles = [regex]::Matches($content, '"m":"([^"]+)"') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value } | Group-Object | Sort-Object Name
Foreach ($g in $allMuscles) { Write-Output "$($g.Name): $($g.Count) paths" }

$content = Get-Content "C:\Users\Home\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\body_data.txt" -Raw

# Remove "const BODY=" prefix for cleaner parsing
$json = $content -replace '^const BODY=', ''

# Show the top-level keys
Write-Output "=== TOP LEVEL KEYS ==="
Write-Output "m (male): exists"

# Extract male front paths - first 10 paths 
Write-Output "`n=== MALE FRONT (first 5 paths) ==="
$maleFront = $content -match '"m":\{"front":\{"vb":"[^"]+","p":(\[.+?\])' 
Write-Output "Has male front data"

# Actually let me extract sections by finding key boundaries
Write-Output "`n=== Section boundaries in file (character positions) ==="
$frontKey = $content.IndexOf('"m":{"front"')
$backKey = $content.IndexOf('"back":{')
$femaleKey = $content.IndexOf('"f":{')
Write-Output "Male front starts at: $frontKey"
Write-Output "Male back starts at: $backKey"
Write-Output "Female data starts at: $femaleKey"

$content = Get-Content "C:\Users\Home\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\body_data.txt" -Raw

# Extract male front section (~23KB)
$maleFrontEnd = $content.IndexOf(',"back":')
$maleFront = $content.Substring(12, $maleFrontEnd - 12)

# Show first 4000 chars of male front
Write-Output "=== MALE FRONT (first 4000 chars) ==="
$maleFront.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(4000, $maleFront.Length))

$content = Get-Content "C:\Users\Home\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\body_data.txt" -Raw

# Extract male back section
$maleBackStart = $content.IndexOf('"back":{"vb":"')
$maleBackEnd = $content.IndexOf('}},"f":')
if ($maleBackEnd -lt 0) { $maleBackEnd = $content.IndexOf('},"f":{"') }
Write-Output "Male back start: $maleBackStart, end: $maleBackEnd"
$maleBack = $content.Substring($maleBackStart, $maleBackEnd - $maleBackStart)
Write-Output "`n=== MALE BACK (first 4000 chars) ==="
$maleBack.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(4000, $maleBack.Length))

$content = Get-Content "C:\Users\Home\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\body_data.txt" -Raw

# Extract female front section
$femaleStart = $content.IndexOf('"f":{"front":')
Write-Output "Female front start: $femaleStart"

# Show first 4000 chars of female section
$femaleEnd = [Math]::Min($femaleStart + 4000, $content.Length)
$femaleSection = $content.Substring($femaleStart, $femaleEnd - $femaleStart)
Write-Output "`n=== FEMALE SECTION (first 4000 chars) ==="
$femaleSection

# Find the HowToSheet function definition
$content = Get-Content "C:\Users\Home\ISOMTRIC\assets\ISOMTRIC.html" -Raw
$start = $content.IndexOf("function HowToSheet")
Write-Output "HowToSheet found at position: $start"

$content = Get-Content "C:\Users\Home\ISOMTRIC\assets\ISOMTRIC.html" -Raw
$musToSub = $content.IndexOf('function musToSub')
$ranks = $content.IndexOf('const RANKS')
$exerciseHowto = $content.IndexOf('const EXERCISE_HOWTO')
Write-Output "musToSub at: $musToSub"
Write-Output "RANKS at: $ranks"
Write-Output "EXERCISE_HOWTO at: $exerciseHowto"

$content = Get-Content "C:\Users\Home\ISOMTRIC\assets\ISOMTRIC.html" -Raw
$ranksStart = $content.IndexOf('const RANKS=')
$ranksEnd = $content.IndexOf(';', $ranksStart) + 1
$ranksStr = $content.Substring($ranksStart, $ranksEnd - $ranksStart)
Write-Output $ranksStr

Write-Output "`n--- musToSub ---"
$mts = $content.IndexOf('function musToSub')
$mtsEnd = $content.IndexOf('function', $mts + 20)
if ($mtsEnd -lt 0) { $mtsEnd = $mts + 500 }
$mtsStr = $content.Substring($mts, [Math]::Min($mtsEnd - $mts, 500))
Write-Output $mtsStr

$content = Get-Content "C:\Users\Home\ISOMTRIC\assets\ISOMTRIC.html" -Raw
$m2s = $content.IndexOf('const MUS2SUB=')
Write-Output "MUS2SUB at: $m2s"
# Read 300 chars around it
$snippet = $content.Substring($m2s, [Math]::Min($content.Length - $m2s, 400))
Write-Output $snippet

$content = Get-Content "C:\Users\Home\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\body_data.txt" -Raw

# Extract and show male back section second half 
$backStart = $content.IndexOf('"back":{"vb":"724')
# Read from position of the "Back" skeletal paths (skipping Shoulders/Triceps already seen)
$backData = $content.Substring($backStart + 4200, 4000)
Write-Output "=== MALE BACK (from ~4200) ==="
Write-Output $backData
